scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime-packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:runtime-packages: npm run build --workspace=@raza-stationers/validation && npm run build --workspace=@raza-stationers/db
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@raza-stationers/validation && npm run build --workspace=@raza-stationers/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:runtime-packages && npm run build --workspace=@raza-stationers/api-server
scripts.test: node tests/phase7/test_static_refinement.mjs && node tests/phase8/test_production_readiness.mjs && node tests/phase8/test_auth_redirect_regression.mjs && node tests/phase8/test_auth_regression.mjs && node tests/phase8/test_bootstrap_owner.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run db:validate && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
